name: hub-mcp
description: AI agent access to Quarto Hub projects: read, write, search, and watch project files over automerge sync.
long_description: Gives an MCP-capable agent read/write access to files in Quarto Hub projects over Automerge sync, speaking the Model Context Protocol over stdio. Files change live as collaborators edit; every project file is also an attachable, subscribable MCP resource. Optionally renders projects for structured diagnostics (opt-in) and answers Quarto usage questions from an embedded documentation corpus.

server.title: Sync server URL
server.description: Automerge sync server for your Quarto Hub deployment.

client_id.title: OAuth client ID
client_id.description: OAuth client id for hubs that require sign-in. Leave blank for no-auth hubs.

client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
client_secret.description: OAuth client secret paired with the client ID. Stored by the host; never displayed.

issuer.title: OIDC issuer
issuer.description: Identity provider issuer URL (default: Google). Must be an https:// URL.
